title: Brazos de la Reina
description: The ambush that ends chapter 1 (src/queen-hands.ts): La Reina Bubbaloo's arms, her own Meshy figure (just character-3d reina-brazo), come down from above the frame and close round Gerard and Bernat in the palace.

steps.caption: Minions burst out of the floor all round them
Her arms come down from above the frame
The hands reach the boys, open
